artists.source_line: LTP presents: BACHAKIZ NOTTINGHAM FESTIVAL 8TH EDITION

features.quote: Anything and everything will take place under one roof at BachaKiz:
features.rationale: The description says all events take place under one roof at the Mercure hotel, where the dancers can also sleep.

features.quote: The 2 party rooms at the moment
features.rationale: The event has two separate party rooms, so more than one dance floor is used.

features.quote: to ensure the comfort of everyone attending the workshops
features.rationale: The text refers to workshops as part of the festival attended by pass holders.
